I have crazy anxiety about going to the vet because I don’t trust anyone, really, and I’ve had several horrible experiences at other places. My little guy is a rescue that has some trauma so we both don’t do well going to the vet. This one though, was just so quick and gentle and I truly trust them. I don’t ever leave my dog anywhere so again, this was just my experience as a wellness visit and to potentially be a client. I’m so happy to call this our vet! Even though this office has all of the information and bloodwork. We need to spend more money on another vet that might also just leave, and we might yet again get left high and dry...and so the process continues. I never leave reviews, but this is a whole other level.

Loved before i went to an appt and my husband and i were ignored completely by staff members.  We wanted to check in and didnt know who was checking people in and the Dr. BARAK himself literally came up to my husband and said "What is your problem?!?" He said were here for our appt. He said "For what?" We said our dog. HE REPLIED "is that the attitude you wanna come in with today?!" We were so shocked beyond belief that he was so awful and rude. We said weve been standing here for 5 minutes with 0 acknowledgement we just wanted to know what to do. He refused service to us. He was a racist. My husband is dark skin and he wouldnt even look him in the eye. He would only address me. Were in our 50s and business owners ourself. Definitely not coming with attitude. It was so surreal. We sat in disbelief. I have 5 dogs and loved vetco but they have someone with some type of personality disorder caring for animals there. The fact he refused service to our dog says it all.

The officer manager promptly made time for us, and they quickly brought us in and treated her. Last year, they also performed a tooth extraction for this same cat, and I was very impressed with Dr. Landa’s care.

Once the appointment was concluded I felt calm, relaxed and filled with necessary information for me to treat my child.

Thank you for the positive review, Joanne Zuniga! We appreciate your support and are glad to know you had a positive experience with us.

It was my first experience with Petco Vets.
They asked me to medicate my cat with a big dose of Gabapentin (which was almost double the amount as my previous vet always recommended) my cat arrived at the clinic very sedated. I asked to go with him to the tests room like I normally do, when they collect his blood and urine sample. I've done this every 3 months for 7 years because of his kidney condition, and all my previous vets always allowed me to go with him...but still, they didn't let me in, they told me they would just measure his blood pressure and come back out for me to join him, but that didn't happen, they disappeared with him and after a long time the assistant came back and said he needed to be sedated because he was "WIGGLY", she specifically said he didn't try to bite or scratch anyone, he was just MOVING!!! And that was the excuse for not performing any other tests. 7 years and I never heard about sedating my cat, who barely knew who he was because of the high dose of medication. Anyway...1 hour drive to get to the clinic, they lied to me about letting me go in with my cat, an over drugged cat, and a lot of stress for them to just measure his pressure....or not, because I didn't see them doing that.
I'm very unhappy with that experience, I will be sharing this story with everyone, so it doesn't happen to others.

The staff and doctors and are this location were very attentive and caring to my pets needs. Prices seem reasonable and affordable, will definitely be recommending this specific location to my friends and family.
Wonderful experience! Minimal wait time, great prices, and phenomenal staff! I felt really supported and well informed to move forward with my dog’s care.
I love this clinic, they are honest and not pushy. Robert the manager was so kind and knowledgeable.

Exceptional Service at Vetco Porter Ranch!

I usually visit the Vetco in Pasadena, but when I needed a same-day appointment for my pup Pablo, I drove 18 miles to the Porter Ranch location—and I’m so glad I did!

From the moment I called, the customer service was extraordinary. The friendly staff went out of their way to help me rebook my appointment to an earlier time given Pablo’s severe pain. When we arrived, the entire team greeted us warmly, and I was introduced to Emma, who truly went above and beyond throughout our visit.

Emma’s care and empathy were remarkable. She took the time to walk me through all of the vet’s recommendations, discussing each procedure and medication in detail while being very understanding of my budget concerns. Her honest, caring advice helped me choose cost-effective options that were best for Pablo’s needs.

When it was time to check out, Emma didn’t stop there. She personally escorted me into the Petco area to find a prescription diet to help with Pablo’s digestion, even picking up a large bag of food for me. She made sure I was checked out efficiently and even reminded me to use my Petco Total Care rewards, saving me an additional $30. She even went the extra mile to bring a shopping cart so I could easily get Pablo and my purchases to the car without a second trip.

I don’t write reviews often, but Emma’s exceptional dedication, kindness, and genuine care truly deserve recognition. If you ever visit Vetco in Porter Ranch, be sure to ask for Emma—she is a shining example of outstanding customer service and compassion.

I thought about going straight to them in person to complain about the deficiency of this place, but not for now.
So I went to this clinic to check my cat. Symptoms were lethargy, no hungry and no drinking much. They came with a plan with over $1,400 (Xray, blood work, Virus test, etc) I declined everything except for blood test and virus test. Xray were pricey. They did the blood test. Dr came and said the result were “a little confusing“.
The test was showing my cat had anemia, but the results were indicating that my cat was most likely having an “Internal bleeding” which it make me feel very scared and they told the Xray will help me to rule that out. So I did the expensive Xray  (About $800 extra) so it wasn’t bleeding but the spleen was enlarge and they send me to another clinic to do an ultrasound because it could be cancer. So at this point I was about to collapse with all this terrible news. When I was about to leave they said “ he has a little bit of fever, but that’s probably cause you brought him with blankets.
I left with no answers and only more doubts and my cat not feeling any better.
On my way home I decide to call to another vet hospital to do the ultrasound. ( not the one they sent me to) I got there the same day about 3 hours after. I told the doctor I wanted a second opinion The doctor immediately told me my cat had 105 fever. He gave him an injection to get the fever down and he also believed my cat might got a bacteria. I showed him the anemia results. He decided to make another blood test. And the result were not anemic and doctor told me the Xray and ultrasound were not necessary, he gave him a steroid injection and antibiotic injection. My cat start feeling better that night. This week my baby’s basically back to normal. Please be careful with  VETCO clinics. I had this experience here at porter ranch. They totally only looking to put more stuff on your bill when they see you desperate. You have the option to decline but they will make you need all those things you declined. Their results were very inaccurate and very irresponsible.
